page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-96-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs and a memory allocation of 756.0 GB RAM, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of memory per core. For storage-intensive operations, the instance incorporates NVMe SSD local storage, configured with 6 local SSDs to support high-throughput and low-latency data access. There are no GPUs associated with this instance configuration.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated compute resources, this server type provides a balanced environment for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The combination of 96 dedicated vCPUs and NVMe SSD storage makes it suitable for large-scale databases, enterprise applications, and data-intensive processing tasks. The resource density supports high concurrent transaction volumes and large in-memory datasets without CPU scheduling delays.
